name: Home analytics & notifications
description: Utility consumption patterns, spending by category, alerts (payments due, maintenance due, budget overrun).
functional_summary: Utility consumption patterns, spending by category, alerts (payments due, maintenance due, budget overrun).

user_stories.i_want: log expenses and income with receipts
user_stories.so_that: I see my home's real cost of ownership

acceptance.criterion: Expense/income CRUD with category, amount, date, receipt photo

design.layout: [Summary cards: Month spend, Year spend, Budget vs actual] / [Table: date, category, amount, receipt thumb, delete] / [Export CSV button]
components: @swal/ui: Card, Table, Button, Input, Modal, Toaster
flow: Add expense/income (category, amount, date, receipt photo) → totals recompute → CSV export
Budget per category set in ConfigEditor

acceptance.criterion: Expense/income CRUD with category, amount, date, receipt photo
